_comment: Central website configuration. Edit, then run `python3 website/build.py`. See README.md and LAUNCH-CHECKLIST.md. Leave values null/false until the owner has approved and verified them; unconfigured items are hidden or shown as 'not available yet'. release.ownerApproved: true is refused unless release-verification.json (written by tools/verify-release.py) matches the release details exactly and private vulnerability reporting is verified.
